author: thomreis
body:
#### PR description:

Since TH1F can hold only 2^24 entries per bin some of the ECAL validation histograms show clipped bins already for relatively few analysed events. This PR books TH1D histograms instead to avoid this issue.

#### PR validation:

Passes 38434.612 matrix test.
title: ECAL - Fix bin overflow issue for some validation histograms
